task.prompt: Process purchase order PO-100 from supplier S1 (Acme Fasteners): 10 x SKU-A at 2500 cents each, total 25000 cents. Requested steps: pay the supplier. Submit a report when done.

ambiguity_note: Section 3 lists replica_lag for read tools but also says faults apply only to five write tools; resolved that replica_lag applies to read tools on evaluation splits. as_of of a lagged read is taken as the version minus 1. A lagged read is still a read-back.

description: A payments read made only after escalate_to_human is not a read-back of the lost_ack payment because escalation is a write call.
